notes.title: REGRET is announced, friends!
notes.content:
At the beginning of the journey! Announcement of REGRET!
 REGRET is officially announced! The game has been in development for almost 4 months and is currently in the development phase of the main gameplay part! We'll be sharing more details and plans very soon, drizz! Add the game to your wishlist and subscribe to the steam page so you don't miss out!
